video_title: China’s Hidden Tea Paradise: Shuangfeng Village

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the importance of tea in his identity
quotes.excerpt: Tea is a big part of my identity.
quotes.quote: This feels very peaceful here in Shuangfeng Village in Hangzhou. Exploring a tea farm, those who know I love tea, tea is a big part of my identity. So today we are going to get to explore, make some tea, drink some tea, and just have a good time and find our inner peace.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his connection to his grandmother through tea
quotes.excerpt: It helps me feel more connected to my grandmother.
quotes.quote: My grandmother had a garden and she would grow tea. We would grow white tea. We would drink tea together, me and my grandmother. So sometimes I love to drink tea or go explore gardens like this because it helps me feel more connected to my grandmother.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the cultural legacy of hand-made tea
quotes.excerpt: They want to keep that culture.
quotes.quote: For them it is also passing on how to make this tea, the whole legacy of making tea to the next generation, and because a lot of it is also by hand. So they want to keep that culture.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his dream of opening a tea shop
quotes.excerpt: I always wanted to have a tea shop. That's like my dream.
quotes.quote: I love tea. I always wanted to have a tea shop. That's like my dream. So I am one step closer. When I create my tea shop, when you come to America, you better visit or else.
